• The transport of sports equipment is subject to available cargo hold capacity. Carriage cannot be guaranteed in all cases and depends on the respective load situation of the flight. {copytext-medium}
  • Bicycles can only be accepted if they are packed in a suitable bicycle case or a similar container. In Zurich and Geneva, SWISS provides complimentary bicycle boxes. In other locations, SWISS cannot provide any packaging material. {copytext-medium}
  • For SWISS Golf Traveller members, the carriage of golf equipment is complimentary in addition to the free baggage allowance on all flights operated by SWISS, Lufthansa and Austrian Airlines. Other code share connections, all myAustrian Holidays flights and flights booked with an Economy Basic fare for short- and medium-haul flights or Economy Light fare are excluded. You may also transport your golf equipment in lieu of the free baggage allowance of your fare type, provided it does not exceed the size and weight restrictions of your free baggage allowance. Transport restrictions for lithium battery-powered golf trolleys can be found on the ‘Electronic devices and batteries’ page in the section: Smart baggage – removable lithium batteries. {copytext-medium}
  • The first ski/snow equipment is complimentary in addition to the standard free baggage allowance on all LX operated flights (including wet lease). For journeys to/from/via the US, this only applies if you are booked on an LX operated flight and on an LX flight number. A fee will be charged for ski equipment exceeding the free baggage allowance if you are booked on a UA or other flight number, on combined flights with other airlines and on the Economy Basic fare on short- and medium-haul flights as well as on the Light fare. {copytext-medium}
